ms.title: “Kenaikan gaji bukan sekadar menukar satu angka” — Alwin Lim gesa kaji keupayaan PMKS dahulu
ms.excerpt: Jika gaji minimum dinaikkan, beri PMKS tempoh peralihan 6–12 bulan dan semak caruman KWSP 2% pekerja asing.

en.title: “A wage rise isn’t just changing one number” — Alwin Lim urges a first look at what SMEs can bear
en.excerpt: If the minimum wage rises, give MSMEs a 6–12 month transition and review the 2% foreign-worker EPF.

zh.title: “加薪不能只调一个数字” 林智成促先评估中小企承受力
zh.excerpt: 若调高最低薪金，应给微中小企 6 至 12 个月过渡期，并检讨外劳 2% 公积金雇主缴纳率。
